personality_one_liner: A soft, expressive, and inviting Material 3 e-commerce entry point driven by tonal purple surfaces and rounded containers.

spacing.rule: Use Material 3 standard metrics: generous inner padding for cards, and 16px/24px screen margins. Group related input fields closely with sm spacing.

dont's: Do not use blur for Material You; rely on tonal separation (surfaceTertiary against surfaceSecondary).

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: A welcoming entry point allowing users to authenticate via Google or standard credentials, or request access via WhatsApp.

states.loading: Centered spinner replacing the form area.
states.error: M3 snackbar or inline red text below the fields.

screens.layout: Top 25% of the screen is covered by `store_banner` with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Overlapping the bottom edge of the banner is the `store_logo` in a circular pill border. Below this, display the store name 'Diana Stuff' in Poppins. Below, place a central `surfaceSecondary` Material 3 Card with `lg` radius. Inside the card: A custom segmented tab control (Login Gmail vs Login Whitelist) with the active tab highlighted using `brandTertiary`. The selected tab renders its respective form fields (Google tap vs text fields + Masuk button). Wrap the whole scroll view in a KeyboardAvoidingView. Anchor an Extended FAB style WhatsApp button at the very bottom of the screen (sticky), ensuring it has proper safe area spacing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Soft Purple (#A855F7) and #FAF5FF background constraints set by the user, incorporating them into a Material 3 Expressive/Tonal design language.
Use Poppins for headings and Inter for body text. Enforce font weights capped at 500 for a clean look.
Implement the segmented tabs using Material 3 chips/tonal indicators, avoiding iOS segmented control styles.
The login card should sit on the #FAF5FF surface background and use #FFFFFF (surfaceSecondary) for contrast, with inputs utilizing #F3E8FF (surfaceTertiary).
Make the WhatsApp button a Material 3 Adaptive CTA (e.g. Extended FAB or prominent Tonal Button) anchored to the bottom.
Include a fallback state for the WhatsApp button when the number is missing ('Hubungi admin untuk daftar' as text instead of a button).
Ensure 'Login Whitelist' includes standard username/password inputs, a Register ('Daftar') link, and handles the pending-approval UI state (e.g. an inline info message).
